scope: Independent offline review of gst-omx borrowed DMA-fd ownership patch. Reviewer did not operate the board or repeat the author build/mock tests.
facts: MemAdapter ion_alloc_get_fd returns its owned DMA descriptor; it does not transfer ownership.
Original gst-omx FOREIGN_MEM_DMABUF branch passed this borrowed descriptor directly to gst_dmabuf_allocator_alloc.
SDK GStreamer gstdmabuf.c documentation and gstfdmemory.c implementation close the passed fd at GstMemory destruction unless DONT_CLOSE is set.
Candidate duplicates the borrowed fd with F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, retries EINTR, and transfers only the new descriptor to GstMemory.
On dup failure the GstOMXMemory wrapper remains unpublished, with foreign_mem NULL and no custom dispose; gst_memory_unref safely frees only that wrapper.
On foreign allocation failure the duplicate is closed once and unpublished wrapper is released. Actual SDK NULL-return branches do not consume or close the fd.
On success normal existing foreign_mem disposal closes only the duplicate; MemAdapter retains a valid original descriptor for FREE ioctl and final close.
limits: Target pipeline must still demonstrate successful EOS/frame content and no teardown EBADF.
Kernel quarantine until reboot and 128MiB cap are unchanged.
No change to MemAdapter get_fd contract, proprietary decoder libraries or kernel is required.
